mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mes_material_issue i JOIN mes_material_issue_input f ON f.issue_id=i.id WHERE i.workorder_id=#{workorderId})

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.output_qty),0) AS output_qty, COALESCE(SUM(component_totals.material_qty),0) AS material_qty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.output_qty>0 AND component_totals.line_count=1 AND component_totals.material_id=#{materialId} AND component_totals.unit_id=#{unitId} AND component_totals.material_qty>0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END),0) AS invalid_count FROM mes_material_issue_input f JOIN mes_material_issue i ON i.id=f.issue_id AND i.execution_id=f.execution_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.issue_id,COUNT(*) AS line_count,MIN(l.material_id) AS material_id, MIN(l.unit_id) AS unit_id,SUM(l.quantity) AS material_qty FROM mes_material_issue_item l JOIN mes_material_issue issue_header ON issue_header.id=l.issue_id WHERE issue_header.workorder_id=#{workorderId} GROUP BY l.issue_id) component_totals ON component_totals.issue_id=i.id WHERE i.workorder_id=#{workorderId} AND f.input_kind='PRODUCTION_INPUT' AND i.status NOT IN (#{voided},#{rejected})
